concepts.gloss_en: The building/edifice of Malkhut of holiness (contrasted with the Malkhut of the klipah)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences sit in the same paragraph: the two clean birds are called 'בנין המלכות דקדשה', and one sentence later נגינה is called 'בנין המלכות' — the shortened form clearly denotes the same holy Malkhut (explicitly opposed to the klipah's Malkhut earlier in the sentence), not a generic sense. The article-less 'בנין המלכות' is a same-referent abbreviation, so merging is safe.
